name: Self Sufficiency
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-sufficiency is not found in human planning or wealth but in trusting God's sovereign guidance and provision. While a man may devise his own way, it is the Lord who directs his steps, calling believers to rely on Him especially in times of uncertainty and darkness. Christ calls His followers to deny self and daily take up their cross, emphasizing dependence on God rather than on their own strength or resources. Ultimately, life and sustenance come from God alone, who possesses life in Himself and grants it to the Son, underscoring that genuine sufficiency flows from union with Him.
